system.description:
Back-Flip. When targeted by an attack from a Large to Colossal enemy, roll 1 Skill Die. On a Wit symbol you take no damage.

Vain (Flaw). While you have 8 or more wounds, lose 1 Core Skill Point from Heart until you've healed.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.87
